补全译文，说明跨学科课程由谁开设。

Interdisciplinary courses {{blank}} by universities have provided students with new methodological frameworks for solving complex problems.

back_content.text: Interdisciplinary courses offered by universities have provided students with new methodological frameworks for solving complex problems.
back_content.explanation: 课程是被大学开设的，offered by universities相当于that are offered by universities。offering会把课程写成开设者，offer和to offer也不合by后的被动修饰。frameworks for solving ...指组织解决复杂问题的方法思路，不是物理框架。

front_content.text:
原句：那些能够在不确定环境中快速调整策略的企业，更可能保持长期竞争优势。

译成英文，保留策略调整能力、环境条件和更可能的程度。

back_content.text: Enterprises that can quickly adjust strategies in uncertain environments are more likely to maintain long-term competitive advantages.
back_content.explanation: that can quickly adjust strategies限定能快速调整策略的企业，in uncertain environments说明环境。主句are more likely to maintain ...表示更可能保持优势，不是确保长期领先。long-term还需保留，不能只译成一次竞争中获胜。

tips: 先看是哪类企业，再核对more likely与long-term有没有被夸大或遗漏。
